## PARTE 1

```{r message=FALSE}
library( tidyverse )
def_area <- read.csv( "def_area_1988_2022.csv")
fires_amz <- read.csv( "inpe_brazilian_amazon_fires_1999_2022.csv", check.names = F, sep = ";" )
phenomenon <- read.csv( "el_nino_la_nina_1999_2022.csv", sep = ";" )
br_presidents <- read.csv( "br_presidents.csv", sep = ";" )
```

#### EXERCÍCIO 1:

```{r}
def_amz <- def_area %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = state, values_from = area)

glimpse(def_amz)
```

#### EXERCÍCIO 2:

```{r}

#def_amz$deforestation
def_area2 <- def_area %>% 
  group_by(year) %>%  mutate(deforestation = sum(area))

def_area2

```

#### EXERCÍCIO 3:

```{r}

def_new_2022 <- def_area %>% 
  filter(year == 2022)

  
def_new_2022$ref <- "complete estimate"
def_new_2022$area <- (def_new_2022$area +1/11)

#def_new_2022


def_area[def_area$year==2022,] <- def_new_2022

#def_area[def_area$year==2022,]

def_amz <- def_area %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = state, values_from = area)
  def_amz$deforestation <- sum(def_area$area)

tail(def_amz)

```


#### EXERCÍCIO 4:

```{r}
head(select(fires_amz, year, total))

#tambpem é possível usando o names
#names(fires_amz)[names(fires_amz) == "total"] <- "fire"
fires_amz <- fires_amz %>% 
rename(fire = total)

head(select(fires_amz, year, fire))



```

#### EXERCÍCIO 5:

```{r}

degradation <- def_area2 %>% 
  select(year, deforestation) 

degradation <- degradation %>%
  left_join(fires_amz, by = "year") %>%
  left_join(phenomenon , by = "year") %>%
  left_join(br_presidents, by = "year")

degradation
```

#### EXERCÍCIO 6:

```{r}

degradation %>% 
  group_by(president) %>% 
  summarise( n = mean(deforestation)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))


```
 Com excessão a Dilma, todos os presidente a partir de 2000 tiveram um alto índice de desmatamento

## Parte 2

#### EXERCÍCIO 7:

```{r}

degradation %>%
  ggplot( aes( year, deforestation ) ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline( xintercept = c(1990.33, 1993, 1995, 2003, 2004, 2011, 2016.67, 2019),
              color = "magenta", linetype = 3 ) +
  annotate( "text",
            x = c(1991.3, 1993.9, 1995.8, 2003.8, 2011.9, 2017.7, 2020.4),
            y = 31000, 
            label = c("Collor", "Itamar", "FHC", "Lula", "Dilma", "Temer", "Bolsonaro"),
            size = 2) +
   geom_vline( xintercept = c(2004),  color = "orange", linetype = 1 ) +
  annotate( "text",
            x = c(2004),
            y = 29000, 
            label = c("PPCDAm"),
            size = 4)
  






```


## Parte 3

#### EXERCÍCIO 8:

```{r}
degradation  %>% filter(year >= 1999) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(phenomenon,deforestation)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
  
  
  

```

#### EXERCÍCIO 9:

```{r}
degradation  %>% filter(year >= 1999) %>%
  group_by(phenomenon) %>% 
  count(president,phenomenon) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(president, n))+
  geom_col(aes(fill = phenomenon), position = "fill" )


```

#### EXERCÍCIO 10:

```{r}

degradation$severity <- as.factor(degradation$severity)

degradation$severity <- ordered( x = degradation$severity,
           levels = c("Weak", "Moderate", "Strong",
                      "Very Strong") )


```


#### EXERCÍCIO 11:
```{r}

degradation  %>% filter(year >= 1999) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(severity,fire)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
  


```

#### EXERCÍCIO 12:

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}

degradation  %>% filter(year >= 1999) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(severity,fire)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  facet_grid(  ~ president)
  
degradation %>%
  filter(year >= 1999) %>%
  group_by(severity) %>% 
  count(president,severity) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(president, n))+
  geom_col(aes(fill = severity), position = "fill" ) 
  



```
